cases.name: Rachel Ann Havrick
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Rachel received her Bachelor of Science degree in Human Services from Bethel University where she graduated Summa Cum Laude. She worked for Benchmark Human Services where she provided care for extreme special needs individuals and drastically improved their quality of life. Rachel enjoyed camping, sewing, crafting, scrapbooking, woodworking, cooking, and even made homemade noodles. She truly had a giving heart and a creative soul; she will be missed tremendously by her friends and family."
